messages:
morgan (product): FYI customer X pushed back — they need per-tenant data provenance for audit evidence. specifically they want a signed, timebound evidence package for any request that touches PII. can we scope this for next quarter?
ashit (eng): quick clarity: by "data provenance" do they mean full request+response payloads or an event chain (who/when/what hash)?
sara (security): they need a verifiable chain. we should provide signed manifests + hashes of the payloads, not full plaintext dump unless contract says so. BYOK wrapping required for tenant key custody.
ben (solutions): customer contract asks: 1) export within 48h of request, 2) searchability for a rolling 12 months, 3) signed evidence package for legal hold. they will accept NDJSON with manifest + signatures.
leigh (ops): storage/cost callout — keeping complete payloads for 12 months across many tenants will be expensive. we should propose tiered retention: 90 days full payloads, 12 months hashes & manifests. sampling for older data?
morgan (product): proposal: phased deliverable. Phase 1 (MVP): per-tenant evidence export (NDJSON) + signed manifest (RS256) + 48h export SLA. Phase 2: retention tiers + BYOK integration + legal-hold tooling + SOC2 evidence mapping.
ashit (eng): technical notes: we can emit a manifest with entries like: {request_id, timestamp_utc, tenant_id, resource, payload_hash, signature_url}. signing can be done by a dedicated signing service; if customer BYOK we wrap signatures with tenant-wrapped keys.
sara (security): must also include key-rotation proof. signature must include key version id and a cert chain. otherwise auditors flag it.
leigh (ops): ops checklist: export job isolation per tenant, rate limits, queuing for large exports, retention lifecycle job to purge content. need a migration plan for existing logs.
audit-bot: deploy pipeline note: "export-service-v1" built on s3://redwood-evidence-prod/ with KMS=redwood-managed (default). BYOK buckets require different ARN and handshake.
ben (solutions): acceptance criteria from customer side: (a) automated export that produces signed NDJSON within 48h on request, (b) manifest verifies against hashes, (c) legal team can verify signature & key metadata, (d) 3 tenants validated in staging.
morgan (product): launch gating: cannot ship Phase 1 to any paying customer unless security signoff AND export validation tests pass for at least 3 tenant types (small, medium, enterprise). also need contract template updated for SLA/fees.
sara (security): we should add regression tests for signature verification and key-rotation. also require threat model doc for signing service.
nashit (eng): timeline estimate: Phase 1 prototype 3 weeks (manifest + signed export), 2 weeks for integration tests + staging validation. BYOK work gated to Phase 2.
leigh (ops): will need cost estimate for retention tiers; i'll put together a monthly cost model for 90/365/730 days.
ben (solutions): I'll draft customer-facing runbook for how to request exports and how to verify manifests. legal will want sample package.
morgan (product): action items: ashit build prototype (due in 3w), leigh cost model (1w), ben draft runbook & sample package (1w), sara security checklist & threat model stub (2w). i'll update roadmap doc and queue for next product sync. :wave: 
ashit (eng): ack, starting prototype. tagging @sara for key questions when I get to BYOK handshake.
sara (security): ack. please ping before any key storage design decisions.
leigh (ops): ack — will include migration checklist for existing logs.
ben (solutions): ack — will coordinate with legal for sample language.
morgan (product): thanks everyone. we should also prepare a short customer FAQ for expected timelines and limitations.
leigh (ops): question: do we want a soft-delete window before purge for exported payloads? maybe 7 days to allow rollback?
sara (security): soft-delete okay but ensure it's logged in manifest and protected by same key policies.
morgan (product): agreed — include 7-day soft-delete as a default but make it configurable in Dedicated/Private offerings.
ben (solutions): sending sample NDJSON schema to this thread in a sec.
ashit (eng): +1 on schema, will review for indexability.
[reaction] morgan (product): :thumbsup:
